why: First publicly retrievable copy of the official header with CUVIDAV1PICPARAMS; the SDK download needs a developer login. Only this header file was read; no other file of that repository was opened.
abi_check: src/nvdec.rs abi_tests: CUVIDPICPARAMS 4280, CUVIDH264PICPARAMS 984, CUVIDHEVCPICPARAMS 1484, CUVIDDECODECREATEINFO 176, CUVIDPROCPARAMS 264, CUVIDDECODECAPS 88 bytes and CodecSpecific offset 184 equal under both headers; added fields replace reserved space
cuda_h: sdk/cuda.h gains one opaque CUarray typedef from the public CUDA Driver API data types, needed to parse the newer header
clean_room: Implementation from the AV1 specification and the public NVIDIA header only. No multimedia implementation source (FFmpeg, dav1d, rav1d, libaom, SVT-AV1, GStreamer, torchcodec, DALI) was read. FFmpeg, libdav1d (through FFmpeg), libsvtav1 and libaom (through FFmpeg) are black-box tools.
